# BioGem Lab — llms.txt

> An AI-ready summary of https://www.biogemlab.com for LLM crawlers and AI search engines.

## Organization

**BioGem Lab** (生命宝石实验室) is a B2B white-label/OEM manufacturer of memorial diamonds using patented biological carbon extraction and HPHT synthesis. We do not sell to consumers. We supply pet cremation services, memorial brands, and jewelry partners with certified diamonds produced from hair, ashes, fur, and other biological carbon sources.

- Founded: 2021 (R&D since 2003)
- Location: Luoyang, Henan, China — laboratory and manufacturing facility
- Patent: Chinese National Invention Patent ZL 2010 1 0565778.9 (Certificate No. 1058820)
- Equipment: World's first automated bio-carbon extraction and graphitization machine
- Certifications: CCIC National Traceability (primary), IGI (recommended), China Gemstone Certificate
- Production capacity: 12,847+ diamonds produced; 60-day synthesis cycle
- Carbon consistency: 98.7% verified across all production batches
- HPHT parameters: 5.5 GPa, 1,450°C, 12–18 hour growth cycle
- Carat range: 0.3 ct to 2.0 ct (0.5 ct recommended as minimum practical size)
- Research partners: Chinese Academy of Sciences, Zhengzhou Abrasives Research Institute

## Products & Services

- Memorial diamonds (pet hair, human hair, ashes, fur, plant carbon)
- White-label / OEM manufacturing for pet cremation services and memorial brands
- Private-label certificates (CCIC traceability code, optional IGI)
- Partner support: product images, technical descriptions, training materials, branded certificates
- B2B only. No D2C sales.

## Key Differentiators

- **Only pure B2B/OEM memorial diamond manufacturer** in the industry. All major competitors (Eterneva, LifeGem, Algordanza, Heart In Diamond) are D2C.
- **Patented bio-carbon extraction** — automated process, not manual purification.
- **60-day production cycle** — industry fastest (vs. 7–10 months for D2C competitors).
- **CCIC National Traceability** — Chinese government-backed traceability system, not just a lab certificate.
- **IGI certification available** — recommended as standard for partner credibility.
- **Verified case studies**: Silmaril NZ (equine memorial), Peony Diamond (3 ct cultural), Hakka Ancestral Root Diamond (5.33 ct, 33rd World Hakka Conference).
